name: Bran Galed
text: Bran Galed is a Welsh hero praised for one great treasure. He owns a horn that pours out liquor in a steady stream. The flow is rich enough to satisfy any guest who drinks from it. His fame rests on that endless vessel, which never runs dry in the old Welsh tales. He stands among the admired champions remembered in Welsh story.

attributes.attribute: famed for a horn that overflows with liquor

okr.objective: Describe Bran Galed, the Welsh hero of the ever flowing horn.
key_results: Bran Galed is a Welsh hero.
His horn flows with enough drink to please anyone.
